high_level_description: The Plaza of the Three Cultures in Mexico City: Aztec stone ruins in the foreground, a grey colonial stone church in the middle, and 1960s modernist apartment blocks and a tower behind.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clear blue sky over a wide plaza.

elements.desc: Low excavated stepped stone platforms and walls of an Aztec temple.
A sturdy grey stone colonial church with a single bell tower and a dome.
A tall modernist tower of concrete and glass.
Long 1960s apartment blocks with rows of windows.
